newsitem.title: USA: Munis yield 83.8 pct of Treasury 30-year - Delphis.
newsitem.headline: Munis yield 83.8 pct of Treasury 30-year - Delphis.

text.p: Delphis Hanover Corp said Tuesday that long-term, triple-A rated municipal bonds are yielding on average 83.8 percent of the Treasury long bond, compared to 82.8 percent Monday.
The jump follows a sharp rally Tuesday in Treasuries. Municipal prices rose only modestly, as heavy supply and continued lagging demand weighed on the market.
